purpose: Normalized source claims that may be used by MathBridge. Each claim uses registered source IDs, bounded wording and an explicit verification/status rule.

claims.claim_en: China's 2022 compulsory-education mathematics standard organises primary requirements by learning stages rather than providing the same type of single-year statutory progression used in England.
claims.claim_zh: 中国2022年义务教育数学课程标准按学段组织小学要求，不采用与英格兰相同的逐年法定课程结构。
claims.not_allowed: Do not infer an exact PEP grade/semester from a learning-stage requirement.

claims.claim_en: PEP's 12th textbook series is based on the 2022 compulsory-education curriculum plan/standards and began formal use in starting grades from autumn 2024.
claims.claim_zh: 人教版第十二套教材依据2022年义务教育课程方案和课程标准编写，并从2024年秋季起在起始年级投入使用。
claims.not_allowed: Do not turn this series-level statement into an unverified year-by-year mathematics rollout table.

claims.claim_en: The current PEP primary mathematics series organises each volume into units, sections and knowledge points and ends each volume with a review-and-connections unit.
claims.claim_zh: 现行人教版小学数学教材按单元、节和知识点组织，每册最后设置复习与关联单元。
claims.not_allowed: Do not claim a full volume table of contents from this general design statement.

claims.claim_en: PEP's new-series introduction identifies counting units as a structural thread across whole numbers, decimals, fractions and operations.
claims.claim_zh: 人教版新教材介绍把计数单位作为贯穿整数、小数、分数及运算的重要结构线索。
claims.not_allowed: Do not infer the exact manipulatives or diagrams used in every grade from this statement.

claims.claim_en: The National Curriculum in England gives statutory mathematics programmes of study by year group across primary school.
claims.claim_zh: 英格兰国家数学课程按小学各 Year 规定法定学习要求。
claims.not_allowed: Do not use statutory wording to infer a single required classroom method.

claims.claim_en: DfE primary mathematics guidance uses structured representations and language to support progression in number, calculation, fractions and other primary content.
claims.claim_zh: 英格兰教育部小学数学教学指导使用结构化表征和数学语言支持数、计算、分数等内容的进阶学习。
claims.not_allowed: Do not describe guidance examples as statutory requirements or universal classroom practice.

claims.claim_en: NCETM teaching-for-mastery materials treat representation and structure as a central teaching idea and use models such as bar models to expose relationships.
claims.claim_zh: NCETM 的 mastery 教学材料把表征与结构作为重要教学思想，并使用条形模型等方式显示数量关系。
claims.not_allowed: Do not claim all England schools use these materials or models.

claims.claim_en: Common Core provides grade-level mathematics standards and Mathematical Practices that can be used as a US comparison baseline, but it is not one nationwide curriculum and does not prescribe one teaching method.
claims.claim_zh: Common Core 提供按 Grade 划分的数学标准和 Mathematical Practices，可作为美国比较基准，但它不是美国全国唯一课程，也不规定统一教学方法。
claims.not_allowed: Do not refer to Common Core as 'the US curriculum'.

claims.claim_en: IES/WWC elementary mathematics guidance supports purposeful use of concrete and semi-concrete representations and number lines within systematic mathematics instruction.
claims.claim_zh: IES/WWC 小学数学教学指南支持在系统教学中有目的地使用具体/半具体表征和数轴。
claims.not_allowed: Do not use this research guide as evidence of curriculum placement or national classroom frequency.

claims.claim_en: IES/WWC problem-solving guidance supports using visual representations to help pupils analyse mathematical relationships in problems.
claims.claim_zh: IES/WWC 数学问题解决指南支持使用视觉表征帮助学生分析问题中的数学关系。
claims.not_allowed: Do not treat the research recommendation as a Common Core requirement.

claims.claim_en: IES/WWC fractions guidance supports developing fractions as numbers, using number lines and building conceptual understanding of equivalence and operations.
claims.claim_zh: IES/WWC 分数教学指南支持把分数作为数来发展，使用数轴，并建立等值和分数运算的概念理解。
claims.not_allowed: Do not use the guide to infer curriculum timing for China, England or a US jurisdiction.

claims.claim_en: A curriculum, standard or teaching-guidance document can show that an idea is required, recommended or illustrated; it does not by itself establish how frequently all teachers in that jurisdiction use the approach.
claims.claim_zh: 课程标准或教学指导可以证明某个内容被要求、建议或示例说明，但不能单独证明该地区所有教师使用这种方法的频率。
claims.not_allowed: Do not convert document presence into a national-frequency claim.

legacy_policy: Runtime should use source_claims_v2.json for claim assembly. The older source_claims.json remains historical and must not be treated as canonical until its IDs/wording are separately migrated.
